title: The half-plane boundary formula at every level forces the whole-plane integral of dφ to vanish
statement:
Let P, d ∈ ℕ, let v = (v_0, …, v_d) be an orthonormal family in ℝ^P, and let φ ∈ TestFormOn univ d (smooth with compact support). Put V₀ := span(v_0, …, v_d) and L_t := {y : y − t v_0 ∈ span(Fin.tail v)}; write Hᵐ = μHE[m] and dφ = exteriorDerivative φ.

Assume (HS): for every t ∈ ℝ,
∫_{V₀ ∩ {y : ⟨y, v_0⟩ < t}} dφ(y)(v) dH^{d+1}(y) = ∫_{L_t} φ(y)(Fin.tail v) dH^d(y).

Then ∫_{V₀} dφ(y)(v_0, …, v_d) dH^{d+1}(y) = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (v : Fin (d + 1) → Euclid P), Orthonormal ℝ v → ∀ φ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) d, (∀ t : ℝ, ∫ y in (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range v) : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ {y : Euclid P | inner ℝ y (v 0) < t}, exteriorDerivative (φ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) y v ∂μHE[(d + 1)] = ∫ y in {y : Euclid P | y - t • v 0 ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range (Fin.tail v))}, (φ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) y (Fin.tail v) ∂μHE[d]) → ∫ y in (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range v) : Set (Euclid P)), exteriorDerivative (φ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) d) y v ∂μHE[(d + 1)] = 0
